about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D165 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Evoque D165 has been part of the Range Rover Evoque range since 2016, using the Ingenium AJ200D and AJ150D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine family shared across the Discovery Sport and Evoque platform. It replaced earlier D150 and D180 badges when the diesel range was simplified in 2020, but the underlying engine family remains the same across both the L538 and L551 generations. The D165 sits between the entry-level D150 and the higher-output D180 in the diesel lineup, offering a balanced combination of efficiency and performance that appeals to a wide range of Evoque owners.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D engines for every Range Rover Evoque D165 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Evoque D165 across the L538 and L551 generations. The AJ200D and AJ150D are closely related variants of the same Ingenium diesel family, with the D165 badge representing the 163PS power output level. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioner, guides, injector seals, EGR components, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
